Medical-grade security & compliance by design

From day one and onwards, your medical data is naturally secure, and your cloud is automatically compliant with global regulatory requirements.

Deliver connected care right out of the box

Instantly connect your devices to ready-made cloud services, add capabilities using templates, and create custom modules to tailor services to your specific use cases.

Innovate fast, freely, and flexibly

Connect, enrich, and elevate care

Deliver care at the speed of need

Innovation alone isn’t enough. You need speed.
With BioT, you start delivering care in the cloud in weeks, not months.

  • Build new workflows as new customer needs arise or market conditions shift.

  • Add devices, services, and features on the fly.

  • And integrate effortlessly with external systems. So you’re not just keeping up with the competition - you’re setting the pace.

Built from the infra out for flexibility

Most cloud infrastructures are one size fits one. BioT is designed to be shaped around your needs, no matter what they are.

  • Freely add or adjust features, update workflows, and redesign UIs.

  • Use it in any setting (homes, clinics, hospitals), vertical (Cardio, Neuro, Derma, etc.), and use case (monitoring, diagnostic, therapeutic, etc.)

  • Power any device: hardware, SaMD, and AI-based medical devices.
